data.name: Yapping Song
data.description: A dragon yapper can use performance to annoy those that hear it, causing them to take a -%1 penalty on attack and damage rolls (minimum 1) and a -%1 penalty on saves against fear effects and charm effects as long as the dragon yapper continues performing. Yapping song is a mind-affecting ability that uses audible components, but is not language-dependent.|1+((BardLVL+1)/6)
